signature.name: VTask.copy
signature.type: {α : Type u_2} -> [BooleanAlgebra α] -> (L : BooleanSubalgebra α) -> (s : Set α) -> (hs : s = ↑L) -> BooleanSubalgebra α

conventions.statement: VTask.copy L s hs = L as Boolean subalgebras (propositional equality holds)
conventions.note: The copy operation does not change any algebraic data; it is purely a carrier-relabeling device.

conventions.statement: The coercion of VTask.copy L s hs to a set equals s exactly
conventions.note: This is the defining purpose of the copy: to make the carrier definitionally equal to s rather than ↑L.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [BooleanAlgebra α] (L : BooleanSubalgebra α) (s : Set α) (hs : s = ↑L), VTask.copy L s hs = L
